scope: Historical validation of the native floating-to-pinned material/frame primitive and guarded JS adapter before controller integration. See sidebar-pin-validation.json for the subsequent controller checks.

capability.geometry: Six CSS-pixel values matching sidebar apply: x, y, width, height, viewport width, viewport height
capability.ownership: Existing visible surface ticket and current main theme ticket; no caller-selected Space or unchecked native pointer
capability.status: -1 unavailable/stale, 0 animation or render pending, 1 animation and target render completed
capability.completion: Keeps target material until the host restores or clears the surface; no asynchronous ctypes callback enters Gecko

implementation: Behind-window emphasized material uses the validated main theme material; within-window Popover and shadow fade out as pinned material fades in
NSAnimationContext uses 80 ms and cubic bezier (.25,.46,.45,.94), with DuringViewResize redraw policy
Renderer layout updates normalized window coordinates throughout frame movement, maintaining gradient/grain origin
Cancellation increments generation before replacing the NSView frame animation with a zero-duration transaction and removing layer animations
Reapply restores normal material and shadow; main theme replacement or teardown cancels the old surface
Native start declines Reduce Motion and fullscreen; complete controller and fullscreen policy still need integration

arcReference.behindMaterialInitializer: 0x100391e8c: blending 0 (behind window), emphasized true, initial material 12, same rounded mask

rejectedCandidates.runtime8: Set destination region too early; normalized-coordinate error reached .00561 while the frame was still moving
rejectedCandidates.runtime9: Correct moving region, but removing CALayer animations alone did not stop AppKit frame animation; late ticks moved a restored surface
rejectedCandidates.runtime10: Replaces NSView frame animation on cancellation; runtime11 also invalidates generation before replacement to cover synchronous completion

limits: ZenNativeSidebar/ZenCompactMode do not yet invoke this capability; their normal pin action is still immediate
Original controls popup movement and page-content resize must join the transition before enabling it
Observed completion polling was about 96-102 ms from the request; recorded CA opacity duration is 80 ms. No end-to-end Arc timing comparison is claimed
AppKit frame updates are sampled and pixel aligned; exact Arc frame-by-frame trajectory is not yet compared
Reduce Motion/fullscreen refusal is implemented but not exercised by changing user system preferences
Five imported Space materials resolve to Light; Dark and automatic/fallback material behavior are not covered by these live probes
Full composed appearance, hover timing, control placement, home/fullscreen layouts, tab dragging and screen-reader interaction remain unverified
